method: Built-in image generation, referenced original Luna; no downloaded third-party character art
promptAssembly: Each socket prompt is common + suffix. The iris prompt is standalone.
commonInitial: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: original Luna 2D VTuber eye socket animation atlas. Image1 is STYLE/IDENTITY reference, NOT a target to copy the whole portrait. Closely match her original understated elegant anime eyes: thin dark plum upper eyeliner, just2 or3 short outer lashes, delicate lower lid, very subtle warm shadow. NO thick mascara, NO giant fan lashes, NO glossy swollen pink upper eyelid, NO heavy makeup. Paint ONLY the isolated eyelids, lashes and clean ivory-white eyeball sclera, with NO IRIS and NO PUPIL because the iris will be another moving painted layer. Each open eye has a softly almond-shaped white opening. All twelve are SAME eye size and identical corner locations. Animate actual upper eyelid progressively descending with slight natural lower-lid rise; NEVER squash an eye. EXACT4 columns x3rows12sprites, rowmajor fullyopen,10%closed,20%closed,30%closed;40%,50%,60%,70%;80%,90%,fullyclosed,happyclosed. Each sprite is completely inside its equalcell, centered, occupies at most70% of cellwidth and40% ofcellheight with generous transparent gutters. Small subtle eyelid skin edge only, NO skin rectangle or cheek patch. Genuinealpha0 transparent background, no text/numbers/borders, no other features. High quality painterly anime illustration same originalLuna, not photorealistic.

eyes-front.suffix: FRONTAL view, one character's LEFT eye percell: inner tear duct corner atLEFT, short outer lashes atRIGHT. White aperture width about2.4times its openheight; gentle elegant eye shape like original, not round doll eyes. Allframes sameanchoredcorners.

eyes-side.suffix: THREE-QUARTER head turned toward VIEWER RIGHT40degrees, one NEAR eye percell (character's RIGHT eye). IMPORTANT anatomical orientation: INNER tear duct atRIGHT towardnose, OUTER lashcorner atLEFT towardear. Do NOT mirror the wrong eye. Draw true perspective eye curving around the head, delicately wider near outer region tapering naturally to nose. Whiteopening width about2.6times height. Separate far eye will be drawn elsewhere, so ONLYone eye percell.

eyes-far.suffix: THREE-QUARTER head turned toward VIEWER RIGHT40degrees, one FAR eye percell (character's LEFT eye). IMPORTANT INNER tear duct atLEFT towardnose, OUTER lashcorner atRIGHT towardtemple. True independently drawn far-eye perspective: smaller narrower almond compared to near eye, with far corner curving away naturally, NO steep vertical oval; whiteopening width about1.8timesheight. NOT a frontal eye squeezed. Onlyonefar eye percell.

eyes-profile.suffix: 65degree nearPROFILE looking toward VIEWER RIGHT. Character RIGHT eye only. INNER tear duct atRIGHT, OUTER lashesLEFT. True independently drawn profile eye perspective, not squeezed front. Eye opening width2.3timesheight.

Top plane upperlid visible, asymmetric shallow whiteaperture following face contour, whiteopeningwidth3timesheight.

notes: The source PNGs are retained unmodified. Rectangles and aperture polygons are registration metadata, not bitmap warps.
Each eye uses 11 blink drawings and happyClosed. The independent painted iris translates behind a per-drawing aperture; fully closed drawings never reveal it.
front/far/down use anatomical-left canonical art; side/profile/side-down use anatomical-right canonical art. Their mirror rules are explicit in painted-luna.js.
13 head base drawings remain finite poses. Gaze is a bounded 2D approximation, not anatomical eyeball rotation or 52 independent facial drawings.
